title: King Oyster Mushroom and Shallot Tarte Tatin
subtitle: with feta and onion jam
description: Caramelised shallots, sliced king oyster mushrooms and onion jam are topped with a round of puff pastry and baked in a pan, then flipped onto a plate and finished with crumbled cheese.

steps.text: Thaw the puff pastry overnight in the fridge. Roll it out on a work surface and cut a 30 cm circle using a large plate or baking ring.

Heat the oil in a deep, ovenproof 28 cm pan. Fry the peeled shallots over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until lightly golden. Add the sugar and cook for about 4 minutes until it melts to a light caramel.

Add the butter and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring, until absorbed and slightly thickened. Add the vinegar and thyme and cook for about 3 minutes until the liquid reduces by half. Remove the shallots to a clean plate.

Slice the mushrooms lengthways 1/2 cm thick and arrange them in the pan, then scatter the shallots over. Spread the onion jam evenly on top and lay the pastry circle over it, gently tucking the edges in.
Preheat the oven to 160°C. Bake for 30 minutes until the pastry is puffed and golden.
Rest for 5 minutes, then flip onto a serving plate. Scatter with crumbled cheese and serve warm or at room temperature.
